Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class AiSearchRestController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.AiSearchRestController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/search") public class AiSearchRestController extends Object
REST controller exposing the AI-enhanced search endpoint.

Provides GET /api/v1/search/ai which retrieves articles via vector similarity and synthesizes them through multiple LLM models, returning a JSON response with side-by-side model comparisons.
